name: Oil-painted iron-oxide red (广红土油)
process: Oil paint in the Qing official manner (油饰), over a 地仗 ground: putty, then three coats of 光油 (boiled tung oil) — two pigmented and one clear. The film is thin, glossy when new, and chalks and dulls in weather. The board's 'lacquer' for the house is the trade's 油漆: Qing official buildings are finished in pigmented boiled tung oil (油饰), not in true lacquer (大漆); true lacquer appears in Chenghuai only as the garden's 广漆.

steps.step: one coat of putty (腻子), ground fine and levelled, wiped with a damp cloth
steps.source: 周乾 Zhou Qian (2024) 故宫建筑油饰工艺里的民间智慧 [Folk wisdom in the oil-paint craft of the Palace Museum's buildings]. 北京晚报 (15 August 2024), republished by Tencent News 2024-09-21, https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20240921A07NT600

steps.step: first coat of pigmented 光油
steps.source: 周乾 Zhou Qian (2024) 故宫建筑油饰工艺里的民间智慧 [Folk wisdom in the oil-paint craft of the Palace Museum's buildings]. 北京晚报 (15 August 2024), republished by Tencent News 2024-09-21, https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20240921A07NT600

steps.step: second coat of pigmented 光油, after rubbing with 青粉 and fine sandpaper
steps.source: 周乾 Zhou Qian (2024) 故宫建筑油饰工艺里的民间智慧 [Folk wisdom in the oil-paint craft of the Palace Museum's buildings]. 北京晚报 (15 August 2024), republished by Tencent News 2024-09-21, https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20240921A07NT600

steps.step: a clear top coat of 光油 (罩面油, no pigment)
steps.source: 周乾 Zhou Qian (2024) 故宫建筑油饰工艺里的民间智慧 [Folk wisdom in the oil-paint craft of the Palace Museum's buildings]. 北京晚报 (15 August 2024), republished by Tencent News 2024-09-21, https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20240921A07NT600

binder.text: 光油 (广油): tung oil boiled with a little rosin powder, 土子 (an iron mineral) and 黄丹 (a lead powder): clear, quick-drying, the least durable of the transparent finishes.
binder.source: 雅昌艺术市场监测中心 (2018) 明清家具透明涂料的成分与鉴别 [The composition and identification of the clear finishes of Ming and Qing furniture], 2018-10-10, https://amma.artron.net/observation_shownews.php?newid=1030835

recipe.text: 广红土油: 光油 with iron oxide (Fe2O3): columns, doors and windows. 二朱油: 银朱油 : 广红土油 about 2 : 8.
recipe.source: 周乾 Zhou Qian (2024) 故宫建筑油饰工艺里的民间智慧 [Folk wisdom in the oil-paint craft of the Palace Museum's buildings]. 北京晚报 (15 August 2024), republished by Tencent News 2024-09-21, https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20240921A07NT600

lightfastness.text: Mineral pigments are in the low light-sensitivity class.
lightfastness.source: Michalski, S. (2018) Agent of deterioration: light, ultraviolet and infrared. Canadian Conservation Institute, 2018-05-17, https://www.canada.ca/en/conservation-institute/services/agents-deterioration/light.html

system.text: 地仗 layer (protects the timber) → 油皮 oil paint (decoration) → gilding where required.
system.source: 周乾 Zhou Qian (2024) 故宫建筑油饰工艺里的民间智慧 [Folk wisdom in the oil-paint craft of the Palace Museum's buildings]. 北京晚报 (15 August 2024), republished by Tencent News 2024-09-21, https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20240921A07NT600

surface.aged: Dull, chalky, crazed along the grain, darker with dirt on rafters and under eaves.

photograph: An even, opaque colour over a perfectly smooth rounded body; a soft gloss when new, dull and chalky after years outdoors.
Fine cracks along the grain and short cross-cracks (断纹) on old work; flakes showing grey ground beneath.
sources: 周乾 Zhou Qian (2024) 故宫建筑油饰工艺里的民间智慧 [Folk wisdom in the oil-paint craft of the Palace Museum's buildings]. 北京晚报 (15 August 2024), republished by Tencent News 2024-09-21, https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20240921A07NT600
